entries.quote: The World Energy Outlook 2000 expects that under the policies and measures included in the Reference Scenario, electricity generation from wind power will increase by 12.6% per year, from 11 TWh in 1997 to 178 TWh in 2020.
entries.note: World figure stated in WEO 2001 about WEO 2000. WEO 2000 itself (Table 3.9) gives wind capacity and generation by region only, with no world total. Base year 1997: 11 TWh.

notes: WEO 2000 Table 3.9 (Renewables capacity and generation by region, 1997/2010/2020, Reference Scenario) lists Wind per region but no world row, and groups solar as "Solar/Tide/Other". Regional rows were not summed (no interpolation). No world solar PV projection.
